Building: Palace of Fine Arts (rotunda and colonnades), San Francisco (exhibition rotunda).
The front (−z) is the lagoon side of the rotunda.
Footprint: 72.9 m along x by 68.1 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (from OpenStreetMap), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[30.8,4.7],[36.4,8.8],[19.8,10.8],[14.5,17.2],[16.1,34],[6.5,21.7],[-7.9,28.4],[-17.1,14.7],[-20,19],[-25.2,15.2],[-22.6,-1.8],[-36.4,-8.7],[-25.7,-8.4],[-14.7,-17.2],[-16.1,-33.9],[-6.2,-21.8],[1.7,-22.5],[4.8,-34],[16.7,-14.7],[27.8,-17],[32.4,-11.4],[21.7,-6.1],[22.3,2.2]]
Height: the highest point is 49 m above the ground.
Model the rotunda only: the long curving colonnades that run off on either side are outside this footprint.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front view across the lagoon of the domed rotunda and flanking curved colonnades, daylight
  2. three-quarter from the lawn across the lagoon showing the rotunda, colonnade at left and trees, daylight
  3. view from the Marina side showing the rotunda dome and the long hall behind it, houses in front, daylight

Reply with the JSON object only.

The three biggest differences from the real building:

1. **The pink columns are invisible.** They stand at radius 18.5 inside a drum of radius 20, so they are buried in the wall. They must stand proud of the drum, at about radius 24.5, to read as the colonnade ring.
2. **The front arches are wrong.** The arcade is a small floating frame in front of the drum. The real front has a large arched portal and openings cut through the drum wall, with the columns standing in front of them.
3. **Proportions are off.** The drum is too narrow and too tall for the dome. The real rotunda is wider and lower, with a broad attic band and a wider, flatter dome. The dome should also be pale copper rather than grey.

json.notes: The Palace of Fine Arts rotunda is a wide, low stone drum of warm buff stone, with a ring of pink-red Corinthian columns standing proud of the drum and a large arched portal on the lagoon (front) side. A broad attic band sits above the drum and carries the pale copper dome, which is wider and flatter than the first model. The flanking colonnades are outside this footprint and are omitted.
